description:

RESUME CHECKLIST (in order):

FIX: tighten the refusal to fire only when the shadowed name is REFERENCED after the block (state.t's $y is; that is the only case the span engine truly cannot handle). Re-check corpus-diff: eval.t must return byte-identical.
2. Sweep method.t / sort.t / scalar.t (their corpus-diff is the `tie my $x` → `my $x; tie $x` normalization — verify behavior parity vs baselines).
3. PCL_V1=1 corpus-diff: v1 output SHOULD be byte-identical, but the ExprToCL `/s` fix (\substr|\pos|\vec multiline operands → p-substr-ref) is SHARED — if any v1 output changes, verify those rows improve (write-through was silently broken before).
4. tools/prove-core (Pl/t gate) + full perl-tests sweep vs docs/fail-baseline; census target 107/4 (chdir #55, postfixderef #45, closure #70, signatures).
5. Add Pl/t regression tests (smallest transpile-test-NN.t): per-instance anon state (push @f, sub{state $x} for 1..2), generator closure, classic containers (state @x/%x = LIST), state ($t) //= 3, expr-position (++state $y, \state $x, my $x = state $y = 42), tie-my capture promotion, \substr-through-do write-through.
6. skip-registry: 'Reference to state variable' row may now pass (stable cell → stable ref) — if stale-flagged, drop the row + trim the \state mention in not-supported.md.
7. Squash/merge the branch to main (one feat commit), cache gen already bumped to v2-38 in the branch.
